meta.title: Practical English – Real-World Phrases for Getting Things Done Abroad
meta.description: Essential phrases and vocabulary for navigating real-life situations in an English-speaking country or when using English abroad. Covers shops, restaurants, hotels, transport, hospitals, and problem-solving. Includes full phrases, not just isolated words.
meta.notes: Phrases are given in natural, polite British English. Where American English differs significantly, alternatives are noted. Context labels help learners find the right phrase for the right moment.

phrases.phrase: Good morning / Good afternoon / Good evening.
phrases.use: Formal greeting at different times of day

phrases.phrase: How can I help you?
phrases.use: What staff typically say to you

phrases.phrase: Could you repeat that, please?

phrases.phrase: Could you speak more slowly, please?

phrases.use: When you're lost in a conversation
